message: Assert used for validation — raise ValueError or use Result.failure()

evaluator_config.message_template: Assert used in function '{name}' — use ValueError or Result.failure() for validation

rationale: Assert statements are stripped when Python runs with -O (optimized mode). Using them for validation means validation disappears in production. Runtime validation must use explicit if checks that raise or return error results unconditionally.
remediation: Replace assert with explicit if/raise or Result.failure() with descriptive message.
